messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — mobile layout bug on Console analytics. On the 'Model latency' dashboard the legend rows are colliding (labels overlap) and tooltips get truncated/cut off on phone portrait. Seen on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. cc @Maya Patel

Maya Patel: Thanks Alex. Is this new after a deploy? Any repro steps or UA strings?

Alex Kim: Repro steps:
1) Open Console -> Analytics -> Model Latency
2) Switch to mobile (portrait) or use responsive device toolbar
3) Tap the legend area or long-press a series label
Expected: labels wrap or scroll, tooltip full text. Actual: labels overlap into multiple rows, tooltip width is clipped and tail disappears.
Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots.s3.amazonaws.com/console/latency-legend-phone-1764805123.png
UA examples: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_4 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.4 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1; Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; SM-G991U) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/112.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

Santiago Rios: I can take this. Quick questions: are any series missing from the chart or just rendering issues? Also can you paste any console errors from the mobile session?

Alex Kim: Rendering + one data quirk. The 'quantized-ggml' series is missing from the legend/series list intermittently (users reported it missing since ~03:00 UTC). Console logs from Android Chrome (remote debug):
```
DevTools Log:
Warning: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') at Legend.js:142
```
No stacktrace on iOS due to limited remote debug access.

Support Bot: [auto] New support escalation created: #SE-5421 — Dashboard legend overlap on mobile. Assigned to eng-platform. Priority: P2.

AlertBot: [monitoring] analytics-prod ingestion lag detected at 1764805100 (delay ~12m) — affecting metric shards us-east-1-3.

Maya Patel: That ingestion lag could explain the missing 'quantized-ggml' series. Good catch @Alex. Santiago — please prioritize layout fix + guard against missing series in legend rendering. If we add defensive checks it should stop the TypeError.

Santiago Rios: On it. My initial guess: recent PR #3721 changed legend container to use `display:flex` for desktop, and mobile breakpoint CSS didn't add `overflow-x: auto` or a max-height, so items wrap weirdly. Also the tooltip element may be behind the chart due to z-index change. I'll try a quick patch:
```
.diff
+ .chart-legend { overflow-x: auto; max-height: 6rem; }
+ .chart-tooltip { z-index: 1200 !important; }
```
I'll also add a null-check in Legend.js before reading `.length`. If I can reproduce in device emulator I'll push a canary to staging.

Alex Kim: Awesome — thanks. If you want I can attach a small recording of the user's phone repro.

Santiago Rios: Please attach if you have it. Plan: reproduce in staging, patch CSS + guard, run canary on staging-console, and then roll to prod if stable. ETA: a few hours. I'll update this thread.

Maya Patel: Adding note for support docs: include a KB entry for "If a series is missing, check ingestion lag + refresh/force-recompute" — assigning to me to draft.

Alex Kim: Thanks all :thumbsup:
